text:
Anya Patel: Heads-up — we're seeing a spike of noisy alerts in the console this morning. Looks like a backend k8s deployment is flapping and the SLO thresholds are firing repeatedly.
Mike Yoon: Ugh. Which SLOs? any tenant impact or just noise?
Anya Patel: Mostly 99th P50 latency breaches on route:/embed/ingest for a few tenants. Console shows repeated 'threshold exceeded' notifications every 30s.
Lee Chen: That sounds like our notify preview fanout doubling for retries. If the backend restarts, each retry becomes a new breach event and fanout re-triggers alerts.
Jordan M: Could be our per-route alert window is too tight. We currently evaluate with a 1m rolling window and absolute threshold. Maybe need debounce + sample-based smoothing.
Sara K: Agreed — want to avoid on-call pages for short pod restarts. Suggest adding a short suppression window for bursts (<2m) and increase evaluation bucket to 5m for p95/p99 checks.
Anya Patel: Proposed quick fix: set a transient 'flap_snooze' for affected tenant routes while we investigate. Not sure if we can just toggle from console quickly though.
Mike Yoon: Console should support a temporary quieting toggle per-route. We have the API: POST /api/internal/alerts/quiet with body {route, duration, reason}. Ops-bot can call if we approve.
Lee Chen: Example payload:
```
POST /api/internal/alerts/quiet
{
  "route": "/embed/ingest",
  "duration": "10m",
  "reason": "k8s pod restart surge — suppress noise, investigate"
}
```
Jordan M: Two followups: 1) add debounce logic to notify pipeline (coalesce N breaches in M seconds into single notify), 2) create a console preview flag to 'suppress transient breaches' so UX can toggle it per-team.
Sara K: +1. Also we should expose the evaluation window in the SLO card (small tooltip) so engineers understand sampling vs instant breaches.
Anya Patel: Ops-bot — can you quiet /embed/ingest for 10m while infra looks?
ops-bot: Received request to quiet route '/embed/ingest' for 10m. Will post update after apply. :gear:
Mike Yoon: While infra dives in, let's add a short-term rule change to avoid duplicate notifications: set notify-backoff: 120s for that route.
Lee Chen: I can open a quick PR to the notify service with a route-specific backoff override and a unit test. Will also emit telemetry metric notify.backoff_applied=true.
Jordan M: For the longer term, we should: [A] introduce a 'flapping detector' that raises an advisory instead of paging for repeated identical breach fingerprints, [B] add a console toggle for 'tolerate short-term flaps' with opt-in by tenant.
Sara K: Agree. Also log a small audit entry in console when quieting is applied so product teams see it happened.
Anya Patel: Action items: Lee -> PR to notify service (patch + test); Mike -> coordinate ops-bot quiet; Jordan -> draft detection heuristics; Sara -> add console audit line. I'll follow up in the incident doc.
Mike Yoon: I'm running the quiet now.
ops-bot: Quiet applied: route '/embed/ingest' suppressed for 10m by Mike Yoon. Audit id: q_2026_33055. :white_check_mark:
Anya Patel: Thanks. Infra: can you paste the pod restart logs here when you have them? small sample is fine.
Lee Chen: PR opened: github.com/redwood/notify/pull/987 — adds per-route notify-backoff and unit test. Putting deploy label on it.
Jordan M: I'll sketch the detector heuristic: if same fingerprint breaches >=3 times within 5m and each breach duration <90s -> mark as 'flap' and suppress paging for X minutes while notifying via console advisory.
Sara K: UX note: advisory should still surface in SLO card with muted bell icon and link to audit + reason.
Anya Patel: Perfect. Let's reconvene in 20m to confirm steady state and decide whether to extend quiet.
Mike Yoon: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy queue active. Lee's PR is queued with tag `hotfix/notify-backoff`. ETA 12m.
Anya Patel: Thanks everyone — will update the incident doc with these notes and link the PR + audit id.
